summary: Iteration 32 polish pass — all 4 items PASS. Backend Saved Meals CRUD: 10/10 pytest cases passed (auth, GET/POST/DELETE, empty-name -> 400, per-user isolation confirmed — owner cannot see or delete member's meals). Frontend flows verified with mobile viewport (390x844) via Playwright: (1) Diet & Health MACROS — meal-save opens meal-name-input + meal-save-confirm, saving creates 'MY MEALS' chip, meal-add-<id> adds macros (calories 280 -> 560), meal-del-<id> removes chip; (2) Food Search — food-add opens food-search box, typing 'chick' filters list from 55 to 2 items (Chicken Breast + Chickpeas), tapping food-opt-Chicken Breast adds +280 kcal; (3) Clan Preview deep-link — from home open-clans -> /clans lists 'test' clan (owner-only), tapping clan-row-grp_40e7cb88f5d3 navigates to /community?group=grp_40e7cb88f5d3 and auto-opens the clan detail (group-back + HOME/CHAT tabs visible, members list rendered), NOT just the generic Groups list; (4) Me/Profile floating LITE/FULL switch — open-settings CONFIG button (bbox 221,12 96x40) and global-mode-full (bbox 325,9 26x22) do NOT overlap; CONFIG is fully visible and reachable via real (non-force) click which navigates to /settings.
critical_code_review_comments: routes/nutrition.py DELETE /api/nutrition/meals/{meal_id} always returns {ok:true} even when no doc matched (e.g. another user's id). Not a security bug (delete is scoped by user_id) but the client can't tell if the id was invalid. Consider returning 404 when delete_one().deleted_count==0. Minor, non-blocking.

AppModeSwitch is absolutely positioned at right:10 top:insets.top+6; profile.tsx topRow has paddingRight:72 to keep CONFIG clear — works, but this is a magic number tied to switch width. If the switch grows, other screens' top-right content may collide. Suggest exporting a SWITCH_RESERVED_RIGHT constant.
seed_data_creation: Test meals were created with TEST_ prefix during tests and cleaned up in teardown_class (owner + member accounts). No lingering data.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Login endpoint returns {session_token, user, ...} (NOT {token}). Use session_token. Backend base URL from env EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL. Owner private 'test' clan is only visible to owner. Web tour/founder gates: dismiss with tour-skip, tour-finish, founder-welcome-dismiss test IDs after login. Web login form uses input placeholders (Email, Password) — no login-email/login-password testIDs on the current login screen; report if standardization is desired but non-blocking. Do NOT test RevenueCat per main agent's note.
